scope: Independent reconciliation of the committed-static-baseline finding only; not a replacement whole-row review or a runtime/Oracle judgment.
rationale: Retain the bounded authoring-baseline failure. The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks!D21 explicitly says "The reference is a committed, static baseline" and Internal Quality Checks!D21 repeats it. Frozen references/quality-checks.md:87-88 likewise says "the reference is a committed static baseline." The reviewed candidate demonstrably meets the static-file half; the available commit history does not contain the repaired reference. A self-contained upload and exact SHA256 manifest establish byte identity and avoid runtime regeneration, but no current policy provides an equivalence that replaces the explicit committed-baseline condition with hashing alone. Therefore Note would waive an expressed requirement, although this is an authoring traceability defect with no demonstrated effect on scoring. It does not require .git inside the uploaded task, a clean whole workspace, or HEAD equality if an independently identified commit contains the reviewed reference.
observations: Read the actual frozen XLSX using openpyxl; Quality Checks!A21:D21 and Internal Quality Checks!A21:D21 both identify check 20 and its committed-static-baseline requirement, with no additional cell comment or exception.

Read-only git rev-parse HEAD returned 254615f9838c1054b136f3490a48757ffcc91d9f. git show of projects/colderwater-playground-devtools/solution/app/src/runtime.ts yielded normalized SHA256 d2fc0471003dd6a2107918be7a2d69f3a96027ec4c56266e6dd9b035a30efd86, while frozen runtime.ts is 7ad7259fd7a1e9c4bfd4cd287a7b05cdcf8341b11553f75c9e5308c0b20751c4. The independent unified diff confirms real changes: instrument gains ThrowStatement/CatchClause source-line tracking; runtime adds rejectionLines/adoptedPromises bookkeeping and Promise rejection propagation. This is not a CRLF-only difference.

git show of public/index.html produced normalized SHA256 d626c675e1fc335f03ba416d32ea4afe2ae1e9e41f004d97045627fc4dba648a and references /assets/index-VduTT3aN.js; frozen solution/app/public/index.html:1 has SHA256 5c5c949d4c50833ff62696d081526da8332aa01ec30ccdb159336ec10f5b10f5 and references /assets/index-0TNzM6xa.js. The latter bundle SHA256 is 502b351d5a32dda111975d970fbb7fc7aa90ab4ade0c361278b0a875bd340f3e. git show HEAD for that bundle returned path-not-in-HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard lists it; git log --all for its path returned no commit.

Additional independent countercheck prevents overclaiming: git rev-list --objects --all DOES contain the repaired source, HTML and bundle blob objects 30ad3577aa240455a23fa6bbf9a15594ff5f67ff, 565e2345602b46f548ff210c278d30cb5f2ff8e3, and 998628456b14d11c5c2de5987aa3b088ae11b633. They are present in refs/codex/turn-diffs/captures/1790760686160/7bd757cc-0da7-4e7d-9bf7-8bd8e7bb4cf1/base. git cat-file -t on that ref reports tree, not commit. git log --all --find-object for each blob returned no commit. Thus recoverable internal tree snapshots exist; absence from the Git object database would be a false claim. Those internal tree captures do not establish the requested committed baseline.

All 50 task files independently match manifest.json SHA256 values. Both JS and CSS assets referenced by frozen public/index.html exist as local static files. solution/solve.sh:25-26 removes the installation DB paths and performs cp -a "$source_app/." /app/; the complete installer contains no build, package install or fetch. The self-contained static upload is positive evidence and does not itself fail runtime determinism.

Initial Git commands without a per-command safe.directory setting were rejected for repository ownership; those failures were not treated as missing-source evidence. Subsequent successful read-only commands used git -c safe.directory=F:/Documents/turing-workspace/model-beraking-prompts. No persistent Git configuration or repository write was performed.
counterexample: False failure to avoid: a reviewed static solution exactly matches an identified release commit or another branch commit, while current HEAD or unrelated workspace files differ; no workbook language requires current HEAD specifically, and the upload need not include .git. False pass to avoid: treating a manifest SHA or presence of Git blob/tree objects as proof of a commit would approve this repaired bundle despite the actual reachable commit history containing the preceding implementation. This candidate is recoverable from a frozen snapshot/internal tree, so claiming lost or unrecoverable bytes would also overstate the finding.
suggested_fix: Record an authoring commit containing the exact repaired runtime.ts, current compiled bundle, public index and removal of the superseded bundle, then bind that commit to the unchanged reviewed file hashes; retain prior reports. No app behavior change, task-packaged .git directory or runtime rerun is implied solely by making this commit.
limitations: Only the disputed committed-baseline finding was independently reconciled. The original row20 runtime/SQL claims were not rerun. No new Docker, configured judge, Oracle, target-model or network run occurred. A P2 failure here is not a claim that the current static upload gives nondeterministic grades.
